strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets a scheduled controller enter the existing headless journey path from runtime-derived product objective provenance instead of inventing caller-authored journey text.
Requires explicit journey authorization and revalidates source product decision, continuation task identity, remaining-capability fingerprints, and objective provenance before journey admission.
Surfaces bounded journey provenance, replay state, next action, and SHA-256 evidence so a headless caller can continue without raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with runtime_permission_enforcement and persistent_structured_ledger support.
answers.new_capability: headless.run.drive can admit a journey from a runtime-derived product objective continuation source without caller-authored task_start goal text.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M61.1/M61.1.1 create the runtime-derived product objective task, but existing journey admission still requires caller-supplied task_start text.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: The autonomous loop can derive the next product objective but cannot safely bind it into the executable arbitrary-repository journey under Rust authority.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M61.1/M61.1.1 task admission and M56 journey admission because this phase uses product objective continuation provenance as the journey admission authority.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive journey_admission surface is extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The existing journey metadata carries bounded provenance; no report, digest, history, readiness, or inspection wrapper is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime validates source continuation provenance and commits/replays/denies journey admission from that source.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Connects product decision -> runtime-derived next objective -> headless journey admission without external controller-authored objective bridging.
answers.milestone_progress: Implements the expected final M61 capability before milestone closeout.

safety_boundary: Journey admission requires explicit authorize_journey_start and authorize_product_objective_journey_admission.
Runtime revalidates source product decision, continuation task identity, remaining-capability fingerprint, derived objective fingerprint, and derived goal fingerprint before journey admission.
Admission does not automatically run provider, tools, workspace apply, shell, git, network, or services beyond the existing bounded journey drive behavior.
non_goals: Does not add a JSON-RPC method, report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or summary wrapper.
Does not require caller-authored journey goal text for runtime-derived product objective admission.
Does not expose raw prompts, raw provider output, raw file content, diffs, stdout, stderr, commands, environments, paths, or secrets.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected a journey readiness report because it would not admit or replay a journey.
Rejected external controller task_start mapping because it keeps product objective to journey translation outside Rust authority.
Rejected a new JSON-RPC method because existing headless.run.drive journey_admission can carry the bounded source.
